fields.Brand Positioning: Clarion Pointe is a midscale, select-service extension of Clarion for resourceful travelers who want a modernist stay—premium touches where they matter, at an affordable price point.
fields.Brand Customer Promise: Convenient, affordable stays with contemporary design, curated food and beverage, streaming-strength Wi-Fi, and a modern fitness space—so guests can maximize the whole trip.
fields.Brand Value Proposition:
Guests: Focal Pointes—contemporary rooms and lobby murals, premium coffee and tea, elevated free breakfast, marketplace add-ons, casting-ready 49-inch TVs, and fitness with on-demand workouts.

Owners: Limited-service conversion play in midscale select-service; strong Clarion awareness; nearly 50 franchise agreements cited at launch (press materials).

Choice: Technology, distribution, Choice Privileges, and decades of midscale expertise.
fields.Brand Pillars:
Focal Pointes — design, F&B, connectivity, and fitness elevated in select-service format.

Modernist midscale — essentials upgraded without full-service cost.

Clarion lineage — social, connected environments extended to Pointe guests.

Conversion-ready — turnkey design packages for renovations.
fields.Brand History: Launched September 2018 as a Clarion extension; first hotel opened in Sulphur Springs, Texas, with 50+ agreements in the development pipeline at launch (Choice press).
fields.Guest Psychographics Description: Resourceful travelers who want modern design, reliable Wi-Fi and streaming, better breakfast and coffee, and fitness on demand—without paying for full-service extras they will not use.
fields.Key Brand Differentiators:
Signature murals and crisp white bedding reflecting local points of interest.

The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf coffee and tea plus curated marketplace.

49-inch casting TVs and streaming-strength Wi-Fi.

Fitness with casting for personal workout streams.
fields.Sustainability Positioning: Supports Choice Hotels' Room to be Green® program and published ESG commitments on energy, water, waste, and community impact.
